scope: Specification inventory only; no SQL/runtime/security proof

gates.title: Lifecycle, replay/identity retention and erasure policy

cards.title: Baseline and isolated harness admission
cards.outcome: Inventory actual foundations and target; define real harness commands/files and positive/negative controls. Do not run prototype as a reset.

cards.title: Trusted actor and privilege design
cards.outcome: Specify verified identity adapter, grants/signatures/search path and role matrix; independently review the trust boundary before mutation integration.

cards.title: Relational expand and migration rehearsal
cards.outcome: Write only authorized isolated migrations after foundations; implement owned constraints/non-reuse and resumable validation with capability off.

cards.title: Common atomic plan commands
cards.outcome: Implement shared private manual/confirmed-apply helpers, normalization, receipts/groups and fault barriers; no nested independent commits.

cards.title: Deletion and lifecycle cascades
cards.outcome: Implement task/context/reminder cascades and epoch advancement; preserve standalone resources/history under reviewed rules.

cards.title: Replication and retained artifact integration
cards.outcome: Connect all writers, consistent materialization and cutover/worker suppression; record full source coverage and actual adapter limits.

cards.title: Evidence and independent acceptance review
cards.outcome: Review all 24 actual runtime results, named migration revision, safe-forward evidence and unresolved policies; no acceptance with NOT_RUN required tests.

tests.title: Target guard
tests.given: Unknown/non-disposable target or missing explicit environment authority.
tests.when: Harness attempts migration preflight.
tests.then: Abort before any DDL/DML; report redacted target mismatch; approved isolated target has a positive preflight.

tests.title: Owned positive path
tests.given: A owns valid active plan, current tasks/reminders and active session.
tests.when: A submits one valid manual edit through the trusted entry.
tests.then: One version increment and one minimal receipt/group; subsequent PG-05 read matches independently read committed plan/reminder rows; mutation response remains receipt-only; no XP or AI debit.

tests.title: Cross-owner denial
tests.given: A and B have distinct workspaces, plans, context tasks and reminders.
tests.when: A guesses B IDs in read/edit/action, direct route and sync; anon repeats.
tests.then: No B record/content disclosed or changed; safe errors; owned control still succeeds; compare B rows independently.

tests.title: Privilege boundary
tests.given: Actual role grants/signatures/exposed schemas and gateway identity adapter are installed in disposable target.
tests.when: Anon/authenticated directly invoke private helpers or forge owner/context; trusted gateway receives forged client owner.
tests.then: Private access denied; trusted code uses verified actor; real service/BYPASSRLS path cannot substitute client owner; inspect all overload/default grants.

tests.title: Schedule and bindings
tests.given: Schedules include overlap, zero length, bad order/kind, duplicate position and cross-plan reminder reuse.
tests.when: Attempt each invalid shape and a valid atomic reorder.
tests.then: Each invalid command rolls back; final valid reorder succeeds without temporary-position false failures; sole reminder binding preserved.

tests.title: Identity non-reuse
tests.given: A removed a block and retained content-free identity evidence.
tests.when: Reuse its ID in another plan/kind, then create a fresh legitimate block.
tests.then: Reused identities rejected; fresh ID accepted; no erased text retained in identity registry.

tests.title: Injected rollback
tests.given: Valid edit changes header and two reminders.
tests.when: Inject failure after each declared write/feed/group/receipt point before commit.
tests.then: Independent connection sees unchanged header/reminders/head/epoch/receipts/groups; prove each injection fired.

tests.title: Lost response replay
tests.given: Valid intent commits, response lost, later plan state may change/delete.
tests.when: Retry same command/key/normalized payload across direct and sync transports; if erasure advanced epoch, first complete authorized v2 reset and retain the original item key.
tests.then: Original minimal receipt/watermark returned if still authorized and retained; no duplicate effects or old schedule disclosure.

tests.title: Changed intent under key
tests.given: Existing receipt for A and one exact logical intent.
tests.when: Resubmit same command/key with changed target/version/block order; permute set-valued arrays as control.
tests.then: Changed intent conflicts; canonical set permutation replays; no additional sequence/reward/AI debit.

tests.title: Two edits concurrency
tests.given: Two connections A1/A2 hold same plan version and independent command keys.
tests.when: Barrier both before owner-head acquisition; release in both orders.
tests.then: Exactly one edit commits; loser gets version conflict; no mixed reminders, duplicate group or lost update.

tests.title: Owner lock isolation
tests.given: A transaction holds A owner head while B uses independent data.
tests.when: B commits owned edit before A is released; exercise bounded lock timeout/retry on A.
tests.then: No unnecessary global lock; B can progress; A rollback/retry uses same key without partial writes.

tests.title: Edit versus erasure
tests.given: A edit/apply references task X; concurrent connection deletes X.
tests.when: Run both commit orders with deterministic barriers and fresh reads.
tests.then: Either edit precedes full cascade or is rejected after deletion; no stale plan/proposal resurrection; epoch and group atomic.

tests.title: Context-only erasure
tests.given: X supplied generated context but appears in no selected focus block; active and archived plans depend on X.
tests.when: Delete X via a legacy mutation path.
tests.then: Known dependent explanations/reviewable copies sanitized; each affected plan incremented once; private dependencies not exposed.

tests.title: Archive restore delete
tests.given: Plan owns bound reminders plus unrelated standalone reminder exists.
tests.when: Archive then restore, also exercise delete and stale action versions.
tests.then: Archive disables/detaches only bound reminders; restore does not re-enable; delete leaves tasks and safe minimal tombstone; no XP penalty.

tests.title: Reminder deletion consistency
tests.given: Reminder R bound to plan and independent reminders coexist.
tests.when: Delete R through direct/legacy/v2 writer; attempt standalone incompatible retime.
tests.then: Binding cleared and plan version/group updated atomically; incompatible retime denied; independent reminders unchanged.

tests.title: Confirmed AI apply atomicity
tests.given: Exact v2 reviewed proposal with optional reminders and one plan.create.
tests.when: Confirm exact operations; inject failure and concurrently repeat apply.
tests.then: One all-or-nothing save/consumed marker/receipt; failure saves nothing; no manual plan.create entry or second AI generation charge.

tests.title: Group and bigint fidelity
tests.given: Owner sequence above Number precision; transaction has companion rows and private filtered change.
tests.when: Commit via each writer; read v1/v2 with page limits and oversized-group fixture.
tests.then: Stored commitment covers full public group; v2 never splits/omits; v1 projection valid; exact decimal ordering; oversized group resets.

tests.title: Mid-batch epoch
tests.given: V2 batch includes erasure followed by another plan mutation.
tests.when: Execute ordered per-item transactions and advance epoch on first success.
tests.then: Earlier receipt retained; later item not executed and marked reset/retry per wire; stale initial epoch writes zero items.

tests.title: Coherent snapshot
tests.given: Tasks/plan/reminder and headers change while snapshot/export job runs.
tests.when: Barrier between section reads and concurrent commit; crash materialization and retry.
tests.then: All included rows/H share one snapshot; retry never appends live pages to old snapshot; cross-bindings and source counts match.

tests.title: Stale worker and artifact
tests.given: Materialized artifact and worker lease exist before erasure/freeze.
tests.when: Advance epoch/revoke lease then attempt finish and old/new downloads.
tests.then: Stale publication denied; old authorized URLs fail at reviewed revocation boundary; already-delivered-byte limits recorded.

tests.title: Migration interruption
tests.given: Clean and populated synthetic predecessor DB, exact baseline checksums and invalid-row fixture.
tests.when: Interrupt every expand/backfill phase and retry under reviewed recovery plan.
tests.then: No silent loss/fabricated provenance; checkpoints resumable; invalid data blocks; old rows/counts preserved or explicit safe-forward evidence.

tests.title: Legacy cutover
tests.given: Pre-group flat feed, old writer and old/new client capabilities represented.
tests.when: Attempt cutover while old writer remains; then fence writers and establish H/reset.
tests.then: Unsafe mixed writer admission blocked; old cursors reset safely or unsupported clients denied; no invented groups from contiguous sequence IDs.

tests.title: Overflow and fan-out
tests.given: Versions/sequence/epoch near maximum; task has more dependencies than reviewed synchronous bound.
tests.when: Attempt increment/cascade at bounds and inject worker interruption if frozen-job path chosen.
tests.then: No wrap or partial synchronous success; safe failure/fenced privacy job per approved policy; affected data inaccessible during unfinished purge.

tests.title: Recovery and suppression
tests.given: Synthetic pre-erasure backup plus separate suppression evidence; new-version data exists.
tests.when: Rehearse approved restore/safe-forward recovery with traffic quarantined.
tests.then: Deleted data cannot become accessible; no blind destructive down migration; source inventory/export/legacy reads checked before admission.
